cards.title: CAP in one minute
cards.body: In distributed systems, Partition tolerance is mandatory on WANs. During a network split, you must trade Availability vs Consistency (CP vs AP).

cards.title: Not a menu of three
cards.body: CAP is about behavior during partitions, not steady state. Normal operation still has latency/consistency trade-offs (see PACELC).
